description: A coin's holders now, as its page shows them: { slot, total, streak, holdHours, holders }, the 50 with the most draw tickets: owner, amount (the coins held now, raw units), tickets, multiplier (1 to 2 with holding streaks, to 3 with staked coins), odds (of its next draw, 0 to 1) and locked (staked coins, raw) when there are any. Its pools, Souvenir's own wallets and the coin's creator are left out: they never win its draws. total is every ticket counted.
name: get_holders
title: Get a coin's holders
